excerpt_i18n.en: On October 28, the 2025 third-quarter reports of public funds were fully disclosed. According to data from Tianxiang Investment Advisors, CATL regained its position as the top holding in public funds, with a market value held by these funds reaching 75.881 billion yuan. In the third quarter, the technology sector performed strongly, and public funds focused their increased holdings in this area, with most of the top ten stocks they added being technology companies, particularly in AI-related segments such as optical modules. Regarding the significant increase in tech stock holdings by public funds, Li Xiaoxing, a fund manager at Yinhua Fund, stated that AI remains the main theme of global technological innovation. Domestic demand for computing power is robust, supply chain bottlenecks are gradually being resolved, and high growth is anticipated for the next year.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 28 de octubre, se completó la divulgación de los informes del tercer trimestre de 2025 de los fondos de inversión públicos. Según datos proporcionados por Tianxiang Investment Consulting, Contemporary Amperex Technology Limited recuperó el primer puesto como la mayor tenencia de los fondos, con un valor de mercado en manos de estos fondos de 75.881 mil millones de yuanes. En el tercer trimestre, el sector tecnológico destacó, y la dirección de las adiciones de los fondos se centró en esta área; entre las diez principales acciones que aumentaron, la mayoría eran tecnológicas, especialmente en segmentos relacionados con la inteligencia artificial, como los módulos ópticos. Sobre esta fuerte adición de acciones tecnológicas, Li Xiaoxing, gestor de fondos de Yinhua Fund, señaló que la IA sigue siendo la línea principal de la innovación tecnológica global. La demanda de capacidad de cálculo nacional es robusta, los cuellos de botella en la cadena de suministro se están resolviendo gradualmente, y se espera un alto crecimiento para el próximo año.

Top News Briefs:
1. Insiders refuted the rumor of "Midea being fined 5 million yuan by JD.com" as fabricated, suggesting clear platform manipulation.
2. Xiaomi undergoes intensive restructuring: Lei Ming personally leads the new automotive division, while Chen Kai takes over Xiaomi Stores.
3. Zhong Shanshan tops China's rich list for the fourth time with a fortune of 530 billion yuan, and Xiaomi's Lei Jun becomes the "growth king."
4. MiniMax's senior research director Zhong Yiran left the company six months ago.
5. Giant Network's CEO Zhang Dong resigns, with board member Liu Wei appointed as the new CEO.
6. Meta's AI division undergoes major layoffs: Llama4's loss to Chinese competitors leads to strategic restructuring.
7. With a 30% commission rate yielding high profits, Apple's services revenue is expected to surpass $100 billion for the first time.

Today's Headlines:
Insiders have responded to the rumor of "Midea being fined 5 million yuan by JD.com" as fabricated, indicating clear signs of platform manipulation. Recently, a series of messages about JD.com enforcing strict pricing policies on merchants during the Double 11 shopping festival circulated on social platforms, including screenshots claiming "Midea Group was fined 5 million yuan by JD.com over pricing issues." On October 28, media sources close to both Midea and JD.com confirmed this as false information. The insiders noted that a concentrated wave of media and self-media outlets spreading such rumors, along with false claims about JD.com's "choose one" policy, shows evident signs of platform manipulation. It is reported that numerous videos and screenshots on platforms like Douyin have recently emerged, accusing JD.com of aggressive pricing tactics toward merchants during Double 11, with many accounts alleging JD.com's "choose one" approach. JD.com's customer service had earlier clarified that they had not received any related reports of "choose one."

Zhong Yiran, directora senior de investigación de MiniMax, dejó su cargo hace medio año. 5. Zhang Dong, CEO de Giant Network, renuncia, y Liu Wei, directora de la empresa, asume como CEO. 6. Grandes despidos en el departamento de IA de Meta: la derrota de Llama4 ante competidores chinos lleva a una reestructuración estratégica. 7. El 30% de comisión genera altos beneficios, y se espera que los ingresos anuales por servicios de Apple superen por primera vez los 100.000 millones de dólares.
